cc:Work.dc:title: Held-out scores, including simple baselines
cc:Work.dc:description: Log loss uses natural logarithms; Brier is the sum over three classes, not the class-average convention. Accuracy is argmax classification. Uniform ties choose home; its accuracy is not random-guess expected accuracy.
